note: Protoss reference openers, one build per /definitions catalog entry (definitionIds has exactly one id; builds with an empty list are scouted-response/patch-native utility builds outside the catalog). Step lists are canonical orders; the sim re-times them per patch. Conventions: PvT builds open core-before-nexus with a unit out by 2:47 (5.0.16 meta); PvZ/PvP macro builds open nexus-first; warpgate research lives on the cybernetics core (5.0.16) - gateway openers research it at the core (PvT builds field their first unit before researching, to hold the 2:47 timing), stargate openers research it after the stargate. Chrono:<Target> tokens are replay-calibrated chrono boost casts (50 nexus energy on the named structure at that point in the order); they come from ReSpOnSe's calibration replays, March-May 2026, patch 5.0.15 - see the replay-calibrated describe in lib/optimizer/__tests__/catalog-coverage.test.ts.

builds.name: Standard Expand (1 Gate)
builds.description: The standard macro opening: gateway, gas, nexus before 6:30, cybernetics into adept, warpgate at the cybernetics core, robo behind it.

builds.name: 4 Gate Rush
builds.description: One-base four-gateway all-in: four gateways before any second nexus, warpgate as soon as the cybernetics core finishes, constant gateway units, hit before the opponent's tech pays off.

builds.name: Blink All-In
builds.description: Twilight blink off 3-4 gateways without a second nexus; mass stalkers jump the opponent's front before 6:30.

builds.name: Cannon Rush
builds.description: Forge first, cannons walked into the opponent's base before 4:30 (proxy placement not simulated), gateway and economy behind it.

builds.name: Chargelot All-in
builds.description: Charge plus seven-to-eight gateways and a flood of zealots off two bases, gas cut after charge starts.

builds.name: DT Rush
builds.description: Hidden dark shrine (down well before 7:30) off one or two bases; the first DTs hit before mobile detection.

builds.name: Glaive Adept Timing
builds.description: Twilight glaives with constant adepts and a safety battery; the timing hits when glaives finish (~6:30 with a high adept count).

builds.name: Proxy 4 Gate
builds.description: Gateways hidden on the map before 4:30 (positioning not simulated), warpgate rushed, reinforcements warp at the proxy.

builds.name: Proxy Robo Opener
builds.description: Robo hidden on the map before 6:30 (positioning not simulated) for surprise immortal pressure.

builds.name: Proxy Stargate Opener
builds.description: Hidden stargate before 6:30 (positioning not simulated): oracles or void rays arrive before anti-air exists.

builds.name: Robo Opener (Expand)
builds.description: Gate expand into fast robotics calibrated to replays: stalker+sentry first, battery ~2:15, robo ~2:53 BEFORE the second gateway, robo bay ~3:55 with observer, second nexus ~4:10, immortal ~4:45 into colossus ~5:40. Warpgate researches at the cybernetics core.

builds.name: Standard Macro (CIA)
builds.description: Full macro line: gate expand, robo, third nexus, charge-and-immortal tech path with upgrades flowing.

builds.name: Stargate Opener
builds.description: Double-gas stargate opener: oracles for harass, expansion behind it, adepts from the gateways - their 25 gas keeps the stargate paid - warpgate after the stargate.

builds.name: Proxy Reaper Response (Core first)
builds.description: When you scout a proxy reaper (no barracks in the terran main ~1:30), it can be in your mineral line by ~2:15 - delay the nexus AND the second gas: core first, zealot from the gateway while the core builds (the saved gas money pays for it), stalker at core finish, expand behind, second assimilator after.

builds.name: Proxy Warpgate Rush
builds.description: Patch-native all-in: one gateway researches warpgate immediately (it stays occupied on purpose) while gateways two and three build, then all three transform and warp zealots/adepts onto proxy pylons on the opponent's side of the map. Map positioning isn't simulated - the proxy pylons appear as regular pylon steps.

builds.name: 1 Gate Expand
builds.description: PvP standard 1-gate expand: exactly one gateway before the natural nexus, adept as the first unit, battery and robo behind the expansion.

builds.name: Strange's 1 Gate Expand
builds.description: Replay-calibrated 1-gate expand variant: sentry is the first unit (its hallucinations scout), gateways #2 and #3 by ~2:40, triple core chrono on warpgate research, robo follow-up ~4:00.

builds.name: 2 Gate Expand
builds.description: Replay-calibrated safer expand: double gas before gateway #2, sentry first, both gateways before the nexus (~2:45 behind the core), robo follow-up ~3:25. No tech building before the natural.

builds.name: 1 Gate Nexus into 4 Gate
builds.description: Expand first, then swing all-in: adept first (never sentry), three extra gateways before any tech building, warpgate by 5:30, and continuous warp-ins off two bases.

builds.name: 4 Stalker Oracle into DT
builds.description: Double-gas double-gateway opener into stargate oracles with four stalkers for pressure, then a hidden dark shrine (~8:30) flips the harass into dark templar.

builds.name: AlphaStar (4 Adept/Oracle)
builds.description: Replay-calibrated AlphaStar pressure opener: both gases by 0:55, second gateway 1:08 BEFORE the core, stargate 2:21, four adepts and two oracles off constant production, nexus ~3:33 behind the pressure, robo follow-up. Warpgate researches early off the cybernetics core, before the stargate finishes.

builds.name: Blink Stalker Style
builds.description: Macro blink: expand, twilight-first blink by ~6:30, three gateways of stalkers jumping in and out of engagements.

builds.name: Phoenix Style
builds.description: Stargate phoenixes for lifts and scouting, adepts behind - the phoenixes ARE your anti-air, so gateway minerals go into 25-gas adepts and the gas stays in the stargate.

builds.name: Proxy 2 Gate
builds.description: Two proxied gateways (before 4:30, positioning not simulated) with constant zealots from the opponent's doorstep.

builds.name: Proxy Robo Opener
builds.description: Robo proxied near the opponent before 6:30 (positioning not simulated) for surprise immortal or warp prism pressure.

builds.name: Robo into Glaives
builds.description: Robo first (immortal/observer) with the twilight added behind it; glaives is the FIRST twilight upgrade and the adept timing follows.

builds.name: Adept Glaives
builds.description: Twilight as the first tech building and glaives as its first upgrade: a pure gateway adept glaive timing, no robo before the council.

builds.name: Rail's Blink Stalker (Robo 1st)
builds.description: Robo before twilight and BOTH before the natural nexus: one-base robo+blink tech, observer for vision, then the expansion lands behind blink stalker pressure.

builds.name: Standard Stargate Opener
builds.description: Stargate before 6:30 in your own base: oracle harass with adepts holding the front, expansion behind it.

builds.name: 2 Base Templar (Reactive/Delayed 3rd)
builds.description: Two-base templar tech with a deliberately delayed third: twilight is the FIRST tech building, charge starts behind it, the templar archives finishes BEFORE the third nexus, gateways climb to six by 7:30, psionic storm starts as soon as the first high templar pair warps in, and a robo adds a warp prism (templar drops/repositioning) plus an observer.

builds.name: 2 Gate Blink (Fast 3rd Nexus)
builds.description: Twilight-first blink off exactly two gateways, the third nexus taken fast, robo by 8:00 for observer/immortal support behind the blink stalkers.

builds.name: 3 Gate Blink (Macro)
builds.description: Twilight-first macro blink: exactly three gateways started before the third nexus, blink by 9:00, robo behind for observers.

builds.name: 4 Gate Blink
builds.description: Twilight-first blink stalker timing off four gateways started before the (delayed) third nexus - more committed than the macro versions, still expecting a game afterwards.

builds.name: 7 Gate Blink All-in
builds.description: Two-base twilight-first blink all-in: gateways climb to seven before any third nexus, the push leaves when blink finishes.

builds.name: 8 Gate Charge All-in
builds.description: Two-base twilight-first mass-gate chargelot all-in: charge plus eight gateways by 7:30 and a flood of zealots, never taking a third.

builds.name: DT Drop
builds.description: Fast tactical DT drop calibrated to a real PvT replay (shrine ~3:13, robo ~3:32, DT ~3:51, prism ~4:11): twilight straight into dark shrine with the robo right behind it, warp prism delivers the first DTs before mobile detection.

builds.name: Phoenix Opener
builds.description: Stargate as the first tech building with phoenixes by 7:00 for lifts and scouting; the second gateway lands before any robo, and gateway minerals go into 25-gas adepts.

builds.name: Phoenix into Robo
builds.description: Replay-calibrated stargate-first phoenix opener flowing into robo: core before the nexus (5.0.16 meta), battery behind the first stalker, stargate before the natural's gas saturates, robo AFTER the second gateway, robo bay ~5:00, third nexus ~5:20. Phoenixes cover the air so the gateways favor low-gas adepts; warpgate researches at the cybernetics core after the stargate.

builds.name: Proxy Void Ray/Stargate
builds.description: Stargate proxied before the natural nexus (positioning not simulated): oracles then a void ray arrive before terran anti-air exists.

builds.name: Stargate into Charge
builds.description: Oracle opener into a twilight built after the stargate, with charge as the first twilight upgrade and zealot macro off three gateways.

builds.name: Stargate into Glaives
builds.description: Oracle opener into a twilight built after the stargate, with resonating glaives as the first twilight upgrade and an adept-heavy mid game.

builds.name: Stargate into Blink
builds.description: Oracle opener into a twilight built after the stargate with blink as the first twilight upgrade - the one stargate build that pays stalker gas, because blink IS the plan; adepts only bridge the early game.

builds.name: Stargate Opener
builds.description: Stargate as the first tech building after the core: oracle harass, battery for safety, adepts holding the wall while the expansion pays off.

builds.name: Robo First
builds.description: Core before nexus (5.0.16 meta) into fast robotics as the first tech building: battery behind the first stalker, robo ~2:53 BEFORE the second gateway, robo bay with observer, second nexus, immortal into colossus.

builds.name: 3 Gate Charge Opener
builds.description: Twilight as the first tech building with charge by 9:00 off three gateways - the lean charge opener before committing to a third base or more production.

builds.name: Standard Charge Macro
builds.description: Twilight-first charge macro: charge by 9:00, third nexus taken, robo added behind for observers - the standard three-base chargelot game.

builds.name: 2 Stargate Phoenix
builds.description: Exactly two stargates of phoenixes to own the air and pick queens; adepts hold the front door against ling runbys while every drop of gas feeds the stargates. No robo, no glaives - the phoenix count IS the commitment.

builds.name: 3 Stargate Phoenix
builds.description: Three stargates of phoenixes - the heavier air-control commitment: constant phoenix production picks every queen and overlord while adepts plug the wall.

builds.name: 2 Stargate Void Ray
builds.description: Double stargate void rays against ground-heavy zerg; adepts plug the wall - at 25 gas they never touch the void ray money.

builds.name: 7 Gate Glaive/Immortal All-in
builds.description: Two-base glaive adept + immortal all-in off seven gateways: robo for the immortals, two sentries for guardian shield, glaives done by ~8:30 when the push leaves.

builds.name: AlphaStar Style (Oracle/Robo)
builds.description: Stargate-first double oracle with a robo and forge all in place by ~8:30 over a fast third nexus - the AlphaStar oracle/robo composition with adept-heavy gateways.

builds.name: Archon Drop
builds.description: Stargate opener (down before the twilight) transitioning into templar archives by ~9:00: high templar warp in and morph into archons for warp prism drops (the archon morph itself isn't simulated - the paired high templar steps are the morph material).

builds.name: Blink Stalker All-in (2 Base)
builds.description: Two-base blink all-in: blink done by ~8:00 with five gateways of stalkers and no stargate or shrine - everything jumps into the zerg third.

builds.name: Carrier Rush
builds.description: Two-base carrier tech calibrated to replays: oracle (not void ray) from the first stargate ~3:50, THIRD nexus ~3:48 before the fleet beacon (~4:40), second stargate ~4:55, forge ~5:00, first carriers after 6:00. Adepts hold the wall - their 25 gas keeps the stargates and beacon paid.

builds.name: DT Drop into Archon Drop
builds.description: Dark shrine plus robo by ~9:00: warp prism delivers DTs, then extra dark templars morph in pairs into archons for the drop (no templar archives needed - the archon morph isn't simulated, the paired DT steps are the morph material).

builds.name: Rail's Disruptor Drop
builds.description: Robo bay disruptors delivered by warp prism before 8:00.

builds.name: Robo Opener
builds.description: Robo as the first tech building - before any stargate, twilight, or shrine: adepts hold the wall, observers deny hidden tech, immortals answer roaches.

builds.name: Standard Blink Macro
builds.description: Stargate opener into three-base blink macro: oracle harass first, twilight after the stargate, blink stalkers and a fast third nexus by ~9:00.

builds.name: Standard Charge Macro
builds.description: Stargate opener into three-base charge macro: oracle harass first, twilight after the stargate, charge by ~9:00 with zealots flowing and the third nexus down.

builds.name: Stargate into Glaives
builds.description: Replay-calibrated stargate-first opener into twilight glaives: void ray then oracle off the stargate, fast third nexus, glaives as the first twilight upgrade and a heavy adept warp-in behind it.

builds.name: Adept Glaives (No Robo)
builds.description: Replay-calibrated twilight-first glaive timing: twilight before gateway #2, five gateways by ~6:00, glaives as the first twilight upgrade, and per the build's name - no robotics facility at all.

builds.name: Adept Glaives (Robo)
builds.description: Twilight-first glaive timing with a robo added AFTER the council for observers and immortals behind the adept poke - glaives is still the first twilight upgrade.

builds.name: Tempest Rush
builds.description: Stargate-first fleet beacon into tempests with an oracle out first - you never go straight to the beacon without a unit.

builds.name: DT Opener
builds.description: Replay-calibrated dark shrine opener: expand first, twilight before gateway #2, shrine before BOTH stargates (the stargates and a cannon arrive behind the DTs), third nexus behind the pressure.

builds.name: Stargate into Robo
builds.description: Replay-calibrated stargate harass into a fast third nexus (~3:50), twilight + gateways behind it, robo for immortals and detection arriving after. Void ray or oracle from the first stargate, adept-heavy gateway production.

builds.name: Stargate Opener
builds.description: The catch-all stargate-first opener: nexus first, stargate before any twilight/shrine/robo, oracle harass with adepts holding the wall.
